rows.body: Radisson Americas integration · U.S. development pipeline

rows.title: Radisson Americas brands fully bookable on ChoiceHotels.com
rows.body:
Jul 2023

Choice Hotels completed a major Radisson Hotels Americas integration milestone—Country Inn & Suites by Radisson and sibling Radisson-family brands became fully bookable on ChoiceHotels.com with integrated loyalty capabilities.

https://media.choicehotels.com/2023-07-26-Choice-Hotels-Completes-Radisson-Hotels-Americas-Milestone,-Integrating-Loyalty-Programs-And-Allowing-For-Full-Booking-Capabilities-On-ChoiceHotels-com

rows.title: Six Country Inn openings in a record development year
rows.body:
Jan 2025

Choice Hotels reported strong 2024 upper-midscale development growth, including six Country Inn & Suites by Radisson openings alongside 26 Comfort openings—while citing a 19-point RevPAR Index gain and higher direct online contribution for Country Inn year-over-year.

https://media.choicehotels.com/2025-01-27-Choice-Hotels-International-Celebrates-Year-of-Development-Success

rows.title: Performance gains and 38 new pipeline additions
rows.body:
Mar 2025

Two years after the Radisson Americas combination, Choice Hotels reported Country Inn & Suites achieved a 19-point RevPAR Index increase, a 20% rise in direct online contribution, and 38 new Country Inn properties added to the development pipeline.

https://media.choicehotels.com/2025-03-10-Country-Inn-Suites-by-Radisson-Achieves-Strong-Performance-Gains

rows.title: Refreshed Country Inn prototype and sharpened brand identity
rows.body:
Mar 2025

Choice Hotels introduced sharpened Comfort and Country Inn & Suites brand identities and value-engineered prototypes targeting 10–15% construction cost reductions while creating more revenue-driving spaces within the same footprint.

https://media.choicehotels.com/2025-03-18-Choice-Hotels-International-Introduces-Sharpened-Brand-Identities-and-Refreshed-Brand-Prototypes-for-Comfort-and-Country-Inn-Suites-by-Radisson
